title: Catacombs
summary: A sealed labyrinth of crypts under the Magma Rifts. Hunt three Bone Wardens for their keys, open the tomb and face the Bonelord.

s.x: The Catacombs are a labyrinth of crypts, buried in the deep rock of the overworld with no door on the surface. You find the sealed stair, dig your way in, and hunt through mazes, ossuaries and lever halls for three
. Each is held by a Bone Warden, a giant skeleton. The keys open the three bone doors of the inner tomb, where
waits. It is the seventh dungeon, and it asks for a bit of everything: puzzles, traps, a key hunt and one big boss.

: solid rock around a square-spiral stair of 18 blocks. Its top is a small sealed bone chamber at about y -41, with a sign reading "SEALED. The dead keep their own counsel.", candles, skulls, a chest, and a cracked wall. Dig down to it and break through the cracked wall. Unlike the other dungeons, there is no waystone here.
Digging into the Magma Rifts is dangerous on its own: lava pools and Fire Beetles. Bring fire protection and a way to escape. See

The west and east doors of stage 1, and the west door of stage 2, lead to a chamber with a Bone Warden. Each drops exactly one Ossuary Key.

The tomb needs three Ossuary Keys, one per bone door. A door uses up one key per click, so the gate is three doors in a row, labelled "SEAL 1", "SEAL 2" and "SEAL 3": "Press an Ossuary Key to the bone."

A rare chest has a 5% chance of a spare key, so a lost warden cannot lock you out.

The Bonelord's Phylactery sells for 13,000 coins. It is one of the eight trophies in a Void Sigil, which summons the Ender Wyrm. See

Kill the Bone Wardens first. They are champions with a lot of health, and each counts as a champion for bonus Reward Chest rolls (two per champion). Do the puzzle rooms on your way: the vault rooms are the best chests before the Bonelord.
Plan an exit: it is a long dig down and a long way back, and there is no waystone.
Dungeon Elites drop Ossuary Keys too, so you rarely run short.
The tomb gate needs all three keys before you can reach the Bonelord.
